# axm commands uninstall

Uninstall a command

## When to use

Uninstall a command

## Usage

```bash
axm commands uninstall [flags] <name>
```

## Arguments

| Name   | Type   | Required | Description                      |
| ------ | ------ | -------- | -------------------------------- |
| `name` | string | Yes      | Name of the command to uninstall |

## Flags

| Name            | Type    | Required | Description                                                  |
| --------------- | ------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `--yes`, `-y`   | boolean | No       | Skip the 'are you sure?' confirmation                        |
| `--force`, `-f` | boolean | No       | Remove even if the command is referenced by other extensions |
| `--preview`     | boolean | No       | Show what would be removed without making changes            |

Global flags are documented on [Global flags](../global-flags).

## Examples

**Remove a command you no longer need**

```bash
axm commands uninstall my-cmd
```

**Check what would be removed first**

```bash
axm commands uninstall my-cmd --preview
```

**Remove without confirmation (scripts/CI)**

```bash
axm commands uninstall my-cmd --yes
```

## Requirements

None.

## Side effects

None.
